morphology.pattern_note: 按人名处理时通常写作 Varun；不可分析成马来语词缀组合。输入未提供音节、读音及爪夷文，故保留 null。

senses.zh_definition: 瓦伦：源自梵语传统的男性名字，常见于印度及印度裔社群；具体中文译名以本人采用的写法为准。
senses.en_definition: Varun, a masculine personal name of Sanskrit origin, commonly used in India.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas lelaki yang berasal daripada bahasa Sanskrit dan lazim digunakan di India; huraian editorial, bukan definisi rasmi DBP.
senses.nuances: 此处采用已见证的人名解释，不能仅凭小写语料确定原文指谁，也不能排除其他专名用途。未取得足以把 varun 认证为马来语普通词的依据，因此不标为 official。以下搭配是姓名使用示例，不代表经语料统计确认的高频搭配。专名用法参见 [Varun 人名词条](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Varun)。

etymology.historical_story: Varun belongs to a Sanskrit-derived personal-name tradition found in India. Its appearance in a Malay sentence illustrates how personal names travel between languages while retaining their identity. Here, it names a person rather than expressing an ordinary Malay dictionary meaning. The packet does not identify a particular bearer or establish that person's preferred pronunciation. See the [Varun name entry](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Varun).
